title: Animated Questionnaire
subtitle: A step-by-step set of questions with progress.

descriptions.contentAnimation: How one question leaves and the next arrives.
descriptions.slideDistance: How far questions slide, as a percentage of their own size (width sideways, height up and down). Needs a Slide content animation.
descriptions.choiceLayout: Choices as full-width cards, or as a compact list of radio buttons.
descriptions.choiceHover: Hover effect on a choice: a fade, or a fill that grows down from the top. Needs Layout set to Cards.
descriptions.choiceColor: Background of the selected choice. Needs Layout set to Cards.
descriptions.indicatorRounded: Corner radius of the check icon box. Needs Indicator set to Check icon and Icon border on.
descriptions.indicatorBorder: Draws a border around the check icon box. Needs Indicator set to Check icon.
descriptions.choiceIndicator: Mark shown on a chosen option.
descriptions.bordered: Draws a border around the whole questionnaire.
descriptions.multiple: Lets every question accept more than one answer.
descriptions.staggerChoices: Choices appear one after another instead of all at once.
descriptions.stagger: Delay between choices appearing, in seconds. Needs Stagger choices on.
descriptions.showProgress: Shows the question count and a progress bar above the question.
descriptions.shortcuts: Keyboard keys that pick a choice, shown on each choice.
descriptions.duration: How long a question change takes, in seconds. Not used when Content animation is None.
descriptions.bounce: Springiness of the question change. Only used by the slide and scale animations.

patches: "flex min-h-[50vh] flex-col justify-start rounded-lg border px-[4vw] py-8"
"flex min-h-96 flex-col justify-start rounded-lg border px-12 py-8 max-md:px-4"
themeDescription: Colour palette. The progress bar, the hover fill and a Primary selected colour take its primary colour.
